name: Future demand readiness
definition: Anticipates changes in volume, product mix and demand.

name: Capacity confidence
definition: Demonstrates sufficient and reliable capacity to meet future requirements.

name: Ramp-up readiness
definition: Increases production without compromising quality, cost or delivery.

name: Localization readiness
definition: Establishes or transfers supply and production capabilities to required regions.

name: Product and process complexity
definition: Manages increasingly complex products, technologies and production processes.

name: Production-system maturity
definition: Uses a structured, standardized and repeatable production management system.

name: Operational excellence
definition: Continuously improves quality, cost, delivery and productivity.

name: Process stability and yield
definition: Maintains stable processes while reducing defects, rework and waste.

name: Flow and constraint management
definition: Improves material and production flow and resolves bottlenecks.

name: Throughput and lead time
definition: Increases sustainable output and reduces end-to-end production time.

name: Operating routines
definition: Uses standard work, daily management, reviews and escalation processes.

name: Capability building and sustainment
definition: Builds employees' skills and independent ownership of improvements.

name: Disruption preparedness
definition: Anticipates disruptions and responds quickly to protect supply.

name: Dependency visibility
definition: Identifies critical suppliers, materials, sites and concentration risks.

name: Volatility management
definition: Adjusts capacity and supply plans as demand or availability changes.

name: Structural adaptability
definition: Sustains supply through tariffs, M&A, downsizing and other structural changes.
